boundary: One symmetric, uniform dead-traction loading of outer top and bottom material layers; no axial displacement constraint, lateral DOFs free. No further fixture variant allowed this turn.
quasistatic_criterion: Not frozen for an admitted dynamic run; candidate duration alone does not establish low inertia, especially compliant crack-arm bending modes
initial_equilibrium: Native zero-load A0 passes; loaded precheck fails residual and small-strain gates
area_rule: Require all original cross-plane interactions intersecting the candidate X column to be absent across every periodic Y bin, and contiguous advancement from initial tip. No proportional conversion from damage count.
nonlocal_area_guard: Also audit all surviving cross-plane segments whose X projection overlaps the column. A discrepancy with intersection-only front is an uncertainty strip; do not certify a unique new area or G until resolved. Full topology includes all long and periodic interactions.

formal_resource_budget_candidate.ramp: half-cosine symmetric traction, amplitude must be frozen from the accepted elastic precheck before any formal run

freeze_note: Admission failed in stage 1, so a complete dynamic protocol was never selected or retroactively invented. This file closes the design; it is not a claim that a full dynamic design was frozen before a nonexistent run.
